main_text.l: D E D I C A T I O.
incolumes, dum interim alia omnia denso agmine, per-
rumpentia in adversis rebus consolationum
ejusmodi fructum penitus intervertunt; ne quicquam
sperant. Optime vero & potentissime ille miserationum
Pater; ille Imperator noster Sapientissimus, suis prospexit,
Divina quadam παναρτλία eos instruens, & salutarium
consolationum suavissima ϑελκτήρια animis eorum
infundens, ut in impetuoso hoc pelago destituti
naufragæ ventis, remos adhibeant gratiæ, positaque sar-
cina peccati adversus infestas malorum omnium, qui-
bus impugnantur, acies certa spe victoriæ, ut fortes
milites & Calliniei Christi, depugnent. Quarum
consolationum efficacissimarum duplex in Scripturis
irriguus fons est. Aliæ enim in universum dulcissimis
promissionibus, quarum lætissima in iis seges, &
intermicantes ubique gemmæ continentur, languentes animos
demulcent: aliæ certa contemplatione personarum,
temporum, vicissitudinum, periodorum Ecclesiæ
modo fluctuantis & luctantis, modo elucantis: lunæ hujus

page.notes: Several Greek words are printed in a spaced, sometimes obscured type and are approximate: "παναρτλία" (probably παρακλησις-type word, reading uncertain), "ϑελκτήρια" (uncertain). Ink damage and faint spots on the page; "Calliniei" and "naufragæ" are as far as the scan allows and may be doubtful. Last line is the page's final printed line.
